syntax.form: OPENW with a negative screen number

semantics.summary: When the screen number is negative, opens the window on the current (top) screen.
side-effects: Creates a window on the current top screen.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed p. 13-34 (same feature: combined update scan p. 14-3)
notes: Only the negative-screen-number variant is declared here; this record does not claim to specify the complete OPENW signature or lifecycle.
